report.input_scope: Seven current final 03_ISOMERS; exactly 163074 selected source records

policy.fit: Theil-Sen median pair slope and median intercept in ln(gamma) versus 1/T; leave-one-out
policy.grouping: Study + full solute identity + audited solvent identity + uniquely compatible maximal observed condition signature across temperatures
policy.condition_assignment: Only QC series metadata may be completed from a unique compatible signature; unknown declarations never bridge conflicting methods/pressures/phases/standard/fixed conditions
policy.no_iteration: At most one uniquely isolated point may be excluded from one series
policy.three_point_protection: 3-temperature exclusion additionally needs factor>=100 and peer gamma spread<=1.5; this is a modelling exclusion, not a confirmed source error
policy.source_values: Input values are never modified, imputed, or replaced with trend predictions
